note: Held-out set drawn 2026-09-17 for the fixes in docs/plans/2026-09-17-006-what-twelve-reviews-found.md. It may score sections 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7 of that register, and section 12's retrieval cascade. It may not be used to find defects and then score the fix for them: gold, seed/holdout, seed/holdout2, seed/holdout_labels, seed/holdout_members, seed/holdout_foreign_xbrl and seed/cases/shapes_holdout.json are the oracles for finding, and none of them may score what it found. Every issuer here is absent from all of those, derived through tests/answer_keys.spent_issuers rather than checked against a list. What spends it: the first change measured on it. After that it is an oracle like the rest, and the next scored change needs a new set from issuers this file does not name. No case states a CIK on purpose: seed/example_drugs.csv has no such column, a person uploading a product types a ticker, and a case that stated one would hand the pipeline the issuer resolution this set is drawn to score.

cases.source: The seller, Ipsen S.A., files nothing with the SEC. The only statement of the product's sales is exhibit 99.1 of the acquirer's 8-K/A - audited abbreviated statements of revenues and direct expenses for the product line - and after the acquisition the acquirer reports one portfolio line and names the product only in prose.
